import pandas as pd
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(data):
    df = pd.DataFrame(data)

    numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include="number").columns
    result = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)

    if len(numeric_cols) > 0:
        scaler = MinMaxScaler()
        scaled_values = scaler.fit_transform(df[numeric_cols])
        result[numeric_cols] = scaled_values
        result["Average"] = result[numeric_cols].mean(axis=1)
    else:
        result["Average"] = pd.Series([float("nan")] * len(df), index=df.index)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    if len(result) > 0 and result["Average"].notna().any():
        x = range(len(result))
        ax.bar(x, result["Average"].values)
        ax.set_xticks(list(x))
        ax.set_xticklabels([str(i) for i in result.index], rotation=45, ha="right")
    else:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No numeric data to plot", ha="center", va="center")
        ax.set_xticks([])
        ax.set_yticks([])

    ax.set_xlabel("Row")
    ax.set_ylabel("Average")
    ax.set_title("Row Averages After MinMax Scaling")
    plt.tight_layout()

    return result, ax
